EmailTemplate.subject: Announcing Flywire Forward's keynote speeaker!
EmailTemplate.textOnly: And our keynote speaker is... Just one week to go until Flywire Forward and we're thrilled to unveil our keynote speaker: Dominique Dawes! ‌ The past year and a half have not been easy, to say the least. And with the Tokyo Games still on our mind, who better than an Olympian to give us the inspiration we need to keep moving forward? You are signed up to attend on September 16th - the only way to hear the keynote is to attend live, so we look forwarding to seeing you virtually next week! ‌ You can view the full schedule here <[[https://hopin.com/events/flywire-forward?ref=2e99c0b21721]]>.
